title: Pure Skyblaster
summary: Pure Skyblaster token-swarming and burn strategy pairing Phantom Skyblaster with Rank 4 boss Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer and Fiend payoffs like Raviel, Lord of Phantasms. By establishing bodies before Normal Summoning Phantom Skyblaster, the deck floods the field with Level 4 DARK Fiend Tokens for massive Link climbing and removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Phantom Skyblaster Special Summons Skyblaster Tokens up to the number of monsters you control when Normal or Flip Summoned, and burns the opponent for 300 damage per Skyblaster monster during your Standby Phase.

Kagetokage triggers in hand as Chain Link 2 upon Normal Summoning Phantom Skyblaster, summoning itself first so Phantom Skyblaster counts an extra body and spawns additional Tokens before overlaying into Castel.
Photon Thrasher Special Summons itself from hand while you control no monsters, increasing your field presence before Normal Summoning Phantom Skyblaster.
The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine can be activated as a Level 4 Trap Monster the turn it is Set with an empty GY to add an extra body before the token spawn.
Tour Guide From the Underworld summons Sangan from Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld, searching Phantom Skyblaster or Kagetokage.

summary.title: Opening: Photon Thrasher + Phantom Skyblaster
steps: Special Summon Photon Thrasher from your hand while controlling no monsters.
Normal Summon Phantom Skyblaster and trigger its effect to Special Summon 2 Skyblaster Tokens.
Overlay Photon Thrasher and Phantom Skyblaster into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer.
Convert a Skyblaster Token into Link Spider, then combine Link Spider and the remaining Token into Muckraker From the Underworld.
Climb into Unchained Abomination or tribute the three Fiends for Raviel, Lord of Phantasms.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer detaches 1 material to flip a face-up monster face-down, or detaches 2 materials to shuffle any face-up card on the field into the Deck.
Raviel, Lord of Phantasms summons itself by tributing 3 Fiend monsters, spawns Phantasm Tokens on opponent summons, and reaches 8000 ATK via Raviel, Lord of Phantasms - Shimmering Scraper.
Unchained Abomination destroys cards on the field up to three times per turn when cards are destroyed by battle or card effects.
Muckraker From the Underworld discards a card to revive Phantom Skyblaster or Raviel from your GY, protecting Fiends from destruction.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Opening of the Spirit Gates searches Dark Beckoning Beast or Raviel, and discards a card once per turn to revive a 0 ATK/DEF Fiend monster from your GY.
Dark Beckoning Beast provides an extra Normal Summon of a 0 ATK/DEF Fiend monster, increasing the monster count on board.
Link Spider turns Normal Skyblaster Tokens into Effect Monsters required for Link-2 and Link-4 climbing.

allow.Raviel, Lord of Phantasms: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms (Level 10 DARK Fiend, 4000 ATK) Must be Special Summoned by Tributing 3 Fiend monsters—which a single Normal Summoned Phantom Skyblaster + 2 of its Fiend-Type Skyblaster Tokens immediately provides!
allow.Raviel, Lord of Phantasms - Shimmering S: Discards itself as a Quick Effect to double Raviel's ATK to 8000 and let it attack all monsters your opponent controls, and tributes 1 monster to recover itself from the GY.
allow.Dark Beckoning Beast: Level 2 DARK Fiend starter that searches Raviel, Lord of Phantasms or Opening of the Spirit Gates on Normal Summon.
allow.Opening of the Spirit Gates: Continuous Spell that searches Dark Beckoning Beast or Raviel and revives a 0/0 Fiend.
allow.Photon Thrasher: Level 4 LIGHT Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters—putting an extra monster on the field BEFORE you Normal Summon Phantom Skyblaster so Skyblaster spawns 2+ Skyblaster Tokens and overlays with Thrasher into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer!
allow.Kagetokage: Level 4 DARK Reptile that Chain-Link-2 Special Summons itself from your hand when you Normal Summon Phantom Skyblaster—resolving BEFORE Chain-Link-1 Phantom Skyblaster so Phantom Skyblaster counts Kagetokage on the field, spawns an extra Skyblaster Token, AND overlays with Kagetokage into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer!
allow.The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine: Level 4 Trap Monster that can be activated the turn it is Set (with no Traps in GY) to put an extra body on the field before Normal Summoning Phantom Skyblaster, then overlays into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer!
allow.Sangan: Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Phantom Skyblaster (1100 ATK) or Kagetokage (1100 ATK) when linked off.
allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Summons Sangan from the Deck to link into Muckraker and search Phantom Skyblaster.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 monster summoned using a Level 4 Normal Skyblaster Token to convert Tokens into Effect Monsters for Link climbing.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend (2 Effect Monsters, including a Fiend) that discards a card to revive Phantom Skyblaster from your GY.
allow.Unchained Abomination: Link-4 DARK Fiend boss (2+ monsters, including a Link Monster) easily climbed into using Link Spider + Skyblaster Tokens + Muckraker that destroys up to 3 cards per turn!

main: Phantom Skyblaster

Signature Level 4 DARK Fiend (1100 ATK / 800 DEF): when Normal or Flip Summoned, Special Summons any number of 'Skyblaster Tokens' (Fiend/DARK/Level 4/ATK 500/DEF 500) up to the number of monsters you control; and during your Standby Phase, inflicts 300 burn damage to your opponent for each 'Skyblaster' monster (including Tokens and Castel!) you control!
Kagetokage

Level 4 extender: when you Normal Summon Phantom Skyblaster (CL1), chain Kagetokage in hand (CL2)—Kagetokage summons itself first so Phantom Skyblaster counts 2+ monsters on the field to spawn 2+ Skyblaster Tokens, then overlays with Phantom Skyblaster into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer!
Photon Thrasher
Special Summons itself from your hand when you control no monsters, increasing the monster count on your field before you Normal Summon Phantom Skyblaster and pairing for Rank 4 Castel.
Raviel, Lord of Phantasms

4000 ATK / 4000 DEF Level 10 DARK Fiend boss: Special Summons itself from your hand by Tributing 3 Fiend monsters—easily paid using Phantom Skyblaster + 2 of the Fiend-Type Skyblaster Tokens it spawns!
Raviel, Lord of Phantasms - Shimmering Scraper
Discards itself as a Quick Effect to double Raviel's ATK to 8000 and let it attack all monsters your opponent controls, and tributes 1 monster to recover itself from the GY.
Dark Beckoning Beast
Searches Raviel, Lord of Phantasms or Opening of the Spirit Gates, and provides an extra body on the field so Phantom Skyblaster spawns more Tokens.
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Summons Sangan from your Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld—searching Phantom Skyblaster or Kagetokage to your hand!
Sangan
Searches Phantom Skyblaster (1100 ATK) or Kagetokage (1100 ATK) when sent from the field to the GY.
Opening of the Spirit Gates
Searches Dark Beckoning Beast or Raviel, and discards a card to revive Dark Beckoning Beast every turn (giving you an extra monster on the field before Normal Summoning Phantom Skyblaster!).
The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine
Activates on Turn 1 as a Level 4 monster to boost Phantom Skyblaster's Token count and overlay into Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer.
extra: Signature Rank 4 WIND Winged Beast 'Skyblaster' Xyz boss (2 Level 4 monsters; 2000 ATK): detaches 1 material to change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position, OR detaches 2 materials to target any other face-up card on the field and shuffle it into the Deck!
Link-1 EARTH Cyberse (1 Normal Monster): converts a Level 4 Normal Skyblaster Token into an Effect Monster so you can climb into Muckraker and Unchained Abomination!
Link-2 DARK Fiend: links off Tour Guide + Sangan to search Phantom Skyblaster, or revives Phantom Skyblaster from your GY.
Link-4 DARK Fiend boss (2+ monsters, including a Link Monster—made using Link Spider + Skyblaster Tokens!) that destroys cards on the field up to 3 times per turn.
